description: Fork of exp165 (per-head MLP h=2048, killed @ step 1000). Modern FFN convention: Linear(64,2048,bias=False) → GELU → Linear(2048,64,bias=False) → LayerNorm(64). LN kept at output (acts as QK-norm). Per-head params 262k (drops biases). 6 layers Q/K ~18.9M. Total budget ~184M. Tests whether modern transformer convention (GELU, no bias) helps for the per-head Q/K MLP.
